items.title: Daycare
items.description: A nurturing environment designed to foster early childhood development through guided play and exploration.
items.copy: Our Daycare program is designed for comfort, security, and sensory discovery. We channel toddlers' energy into purposeful play — building vocabulary, developing motor skills, and learning to navigate friendships. For preschool, we blend structured learning with imaginative play, ensuring your child is kindergarten ready.
highlights: Language-rich environment with stories and songs
Art, water play, and outdoor exploration
Early social skills and gentle conflict resolution

items.title: Tutoring
items.description: Personalized academic support to help students build confidence and excel in their studies.
items.tagline: Empowering students to reach their full potential.
items.copy: Our Tutoring programs offer dedicated support tailored to each student's learning style. Whether through focused one-on-one private sessions or collaborative group environments, our experienced educators help clarify complex concepts, reinforce foundational skills, and develop effective study habits for lasting academic success.

items.title: Community Learning (PKBM)
items.description: Alternative schooling paths providing flexible, accredited education for all levels.
items.tagline: Flexible paths to formal education equivalence.
items.copy: Our Community Learning Center (PKBM) offers non-formal educational pathways equivalent to formal schooling. We provide structured yet flexible learning environments for Paket A (Elementary), Paket B (Junior High), and Paket C (Senior High). This program is ideal for individuals seeking an alternative route to earn recognized diplomas while accommodating their unique life circumstances.
